extraction.tier_rationale: Externally validated across multiple independent populations spanning neonates to the obese elderly; the broadest-envelope general-purpose propofol model. The executable kernel is now implemented (arterial-sampling PK arm), transcribed from the published equations and cross-checked against the tci R package, and validated to reproduce the reference-individual parameters exactly. review_status remains UNVERIFIED: an LLM transcription is not a human PDF verification, and the maturation/allometry terms are exactly where transcription errors hide. A human must still confirm every covariate equation before this is promoted.
extraction.source_locator: Eleveld 2018, Table 2 / Appendix
